description: August 3, 2026 Chiaradio Attends East Mississippi Day of Action Meridian, MS — Democratic nominee for Congress Michael A. Chiaradio attended the East Mississippi Day of Action: The People’s Hearing last week, joining community members and partner organizations for a discussion focused on voting rights, civic engagement, and increasing voter participation ahead of the November election. The event brought together residents from across Mississippi who are committed to strengthening civic participation and encouraging voter engagement throughout their communities. Chiaradio met with attendees and discussed the importance of grassroots organizing as the campaign continues to build throughout Mississippi’s Third Congressional District. The meeting reflects the growing enthusiasm surrounding the 2026 election and the continued efforts of local organizations and volunteers to ensure every eligible voter has the opportunity to make their voice heard. Mississippi’s Third Congressional District remains the most competitive U.S. House race in the state. The Chiaradio campaign continues organizing across all twenty-three counties with a focus on lowering healthcare costs, investing in infrastructure, strengthening public schools, and supporting small businesses and local food systems. To help Michael A. Chiaradio continue building across Mississippi’s Third Congressional District, please contribute today: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-a-chiaradio
title: Chiaradio Attends East Mississippi Day of Action - Michael A Chiaradio
